resetBody: This deletes this browser’s saved answers across all languages. Downloaded files are not deleted. This cannot be undone.
question: Question {n} / {total}
placeholder: You can name a favorite game or work, explain why, or describe a situation.
instruction: Choose an option, write your own answer, or select a response status. All questions need a response before export.
intro: An experiment in relationship portability across AI sessions and platforms. Start with observations; let dialogue develop the relationship.
reviewTitle: A starting point for your next AI relationship.
reviewIntro: Check your answers before sharing. Unknown and declined are meaningful responses, not missing data.
exportTitle: Give the complete file to an AI
exportIntro: Both formats include the schema, handling instructions and your initial observations. Nothing is sent to the creator.
author: Created by
saveError: Local saving is unavailable. Keep this page open until export.
required: Respond to every question before exporting.
loadError: The questionnaire could not be loaded. Your saved answers have not been changed.
noJs: JavaScript is required to answer and export. Public documentation and the question list remain readable without it.
copyError: Copy was unavailable. Select and copy the text below.
exportNote: Read the embedded protocol before applying or updating this record. The JSON is the complete canonical record. Free text is preserved in its original language.
keyboard: Keyboard: 1–4 to choose; left/right arrows to move when not editing.
experimental: Experimental release; translations have not received independent native-speaker validation.
